title: Career Roadmap: CFO
summary: Career Domain: Business, Finance & Entrepreneurship · Qualification Pathway: Professional Certifications - CA / CS / CMA / ACCA / CFA / CPA-India – Chartered Accountancy (CA - ICAI) · Target Career: CFO

facts.Current degree: Professional Certifications - CA / CS / CMA / ACCA / CFA / CPA-India

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Chief Financial Officer leads a company's finances - planning, funding, reporting, risk and investor relations - and is one of the top decision-makers. It is reached after 15 years or more in finance.

items.text: Raise funds and manage cash and capital
Advise the CEO and board on major decisions
Read business news and annual reports
Get audit plus tax and advisory exposure

blocks.text: Final and career: Qualify and grow

items.text: Start in audit, FP&A or controllership
Move across roles to build all-round finance experience

blocks.label: Note
blocks.text: CFO is a leadership role, usually reached after 15-20 years across reporting, FP&A, treasury and business finance.

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
